notes:
Account snapshot and evaluation plan:
- Company: mid-size vertical search vendor for legal & compliance teams. Heavy RAG/semantic search workload. Index ~120M documents (mix of contracts, emails, filings).
- Current stack: SBERT-based embeddings + lightweight logistic reranker. They run on a self-hosted cluster (EU + NA).
- Problem statement: wanting 3x better recall at top-5 for entity queries while keeping median qps latency under 200ms and query cost < $0.015 per query. Also need deterministic canary/A-B plan and eval-driven migration to avoid model regressions.
- Tech preferences: open models preferred (Llama2/Mistral), but flexibility to accept Redwood-curated quantized variants. Prefer dedicated GPU pools for production.
- Security: strict EU data residency for legal docs. Require SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance, KMS integration for key rotation, and full audit logs.
- Success criteria for migration POC (agreed 2026-02-21 call):
  * Embedding quality: maintain or improve MAP@5 vs SBERT baseline on benchmark set (5,000 labeled queries)
  * Reranker: zero statistically-significant degradation in top-1 precision across 12 categories; if small regression, must be remediable via prompt/feature-tuning in 2 iterations
  * Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 320ms for combined embed+rerank in Dedicated plan
  * Cost: projected per-query cost delta <= +20% vs current infra or justify ROI via accuracy gains
- Eval plan: building a 5k labeled query eval set + 100k unlabeled traffic-sampled queries. Will run embedding candidate A/B on 20% of traffic for 2 weeks, then reranker canary on 10% with Redwood fallbacks. We will use Redwood Optimize to get batching/quantization suggestions.
- Timeline / recent activity:
  * 2026-02-21: Kickoff call (owner + SE + Head of ML). Action: Redwood to provide POC sizing estimate and suggested candidate models. (ff_2026-02-21_0451)
  * 2026-02-28: Redwood submitted sizing & pricing deck (drive link). SE: Ethan Park set up initial eval harness. (gmail.thread/CAHkX2e-9f_orbit_poc)
  * 2026-03-05: Security review triage call. Orbit requested SOC2 attestation + KMS integration docs. (ff_2026-03-05_1732, drive://orbitiris/security-questionnaire-03-2026)
  * 2026-03-08: Internal dataset prepared (5k human-labeled queries). Running baseline evaluation.
- Risks & mitigations:
  * Risk: Reranker migration causes precision drop in legal-entity extraction. Mitigation: canary routing with automatic fallback to baseline reranker; gating on evaluation thresholds; Redwood Optimize suggested hybrid reranker + ruleset.
  * Risk: Indexing/serving cost spike at 100M doc scale. Mitigation: Redwood to propose KV-caching and sharded Dedicated pools; evaluate quantized model for embeddings to reduce GPU memory footprint.
- Commercial notes: preferred contract is 12–24 month committed Dedicated pool with dedicated on-prem connector for EU cluster. CFO wants ARR band and clear unit-cost model before procurement approval.
- Quotes / customer language captured on calls:
  * "We will not accept any invisible regressions in legal entity recall — that is a hard stop." — Head of ML
  * "If you can show deterministic rollback + canary plan we can sign for Dedicated capacity." — VP Product
- Next steps (owner + SE):
  1) Redwood runs candidate embedding evals on labeled set by 2026-03-18.
  2) SE (Ethan) to provision Dedicated test pool for 100M doc indexing demo by 2026-03-25.
  3) Schedule canary routing window (10% traffic) for 2 weeks after internal pass.

  * POC: embed migration -> reranker migration -> canary -> rollout.
  * Primary constraint: quality gates + EU residency.
  * Decision makers: Head of ML (evaluation), VP Product (procurement), CFO (budget).
